issue: Reused seed manifest retained the source absolute sqlitePath, so the first gate augmented the old .tmp seed and the copied run returned zero snapshot rows.
resolution: Force manifest.sqlitePath to outputDir/chat.sqlite before opening; rebuild the P2C seed. No repository, production, or external data was touched.

issue: A table-level model-usage CHECK was placed before created_at/updated_at column declarations, producing SQLITE_ERROR on fresh schema creation.
resolution: Move the table-level CHECK after all column declarations; fresh real-SQLite tests returned 6/6 green.
